question: The English novel ‘Little Women’ was written by which of the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Louisa May Alcott**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Louisa May Alcott **wrote the English novel Little Women **
 
• **Louisa May Alcott (1832-1888) was an American writer and feminist.** 
 
• The first volume of Little Women was **published on September 30, 1868**. 
 
• The **semi-autobiographical novel is about Alcott's time spent with her sisters in Concord, Massachusetts. **
 
• **The book was inspired by Alcott's family.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
